descriptions.text: I don't even know what the hell this is. This bitch is coloring outside the lines.

recap.text: Eris spits into her hand and makes a poker-chip coin, shows four fates: Donut's face with RIP, Carl with bloody severed feet, a pile of dead friends, and Carl hanging upside down by one foot, smiling. Carl grabs the coin as Uzi Jesus flips it, and it burns in his fist until it dissolves into a spinning swirl tattoo. Eris kisses him and gives him until the end of the twelfth floor to learn how the fifth side lands.

beats.headline: Four sides on a coin
beats.text: Eris spits into her hand and a coin appears, about the size of a poker chip, her laughing face on one side and a swirl on the other. Then she reveals its sides. Donut's face and RIP. Carl de-feeted, with a pair of bloody severed feet. A pile of bodies: Most of my friends are dead. Carl hanging upside down by one foot from a tree branch, smiling, player-killer skulls round the edge: I become what they accuse me of. One of the four has to happen before the Ascendent is chosen. She hands it to Uzi Jesus to flip, and Carl grabs it in midair.
beats.gist: Eris's coin shows four fates, and Carl snatches it midair before Uzi Jesus can flip it.

beats.headline: The fifth side
beats.text: The coin burns in Carl's right fist and he does not let go. You picked the fifth side, Eris says, clapping: chaos wins again. The coin dissolves, and on his palm is a swirl pattern tattoo that spins on its own, like a slow-motion Signet tattoo. When he examines it, the System does not know what it is either. The fifth choice, Eris explains, is one of the other four, or two of them, or three, or all of them, or none of them. Chaos. Random. She kisses him on the lips: they will see what he gets.
beats.gist: Carl holds the burning coin until it dissolves, and Eris declares chaos wins, leaving a spinning swirl tattoo.

beats.headline: Shown to the chat
beats.text: Carl writes down everything he saw and heard, starting with the four sides of the coin. Grabbing it unlocked the fifth choice and made everything random, and he wonders whether that made things much worse. Then, back with the others, he holds up his hand to show the swirl and explains it all in chat. The chat explodes. Hanging out with him, Elle writes, is as dangerous as hanging out with Samantha.
beats.gist: Carl shows the chat the swirl on his palm, and Elle says he is as dangerous as Samantha.

beats.headline: Until the end of the twelfth
beats.text: With Scolopendra a puddle, Eris, huge, tells Carl she does not need his worship: he is chaos incarnate. Does he know how doors work? Every exit is an entrance. And don't forget about the coin, she says. They have until the end of the twelfth floor to figure out how the fifth side lands. Then she is gone in a puff of smoke, and the world unfreezes.
beats.gist: Eris gives Carl until the twelfth floor ends to figure out the coin's fifth side.

relations.note: now a tattoo on his palm
